## Other formats

### .act

768-byte RGB palette

### .cbk

u32 n, n*16 tile bytes

### .dat

text: engsnd_Load 0x469b00: sscanf 11 fields per non-# line

### .def

text: definitions

### .elt

text: elt_Load 0x448010: dst/src <map>, label <name> x y w h, '#' comments

### .fnt

i76fmt.fnt: '1.' fonts

### .frc

i76fmt.frc: RIFF FORC force-feedback effects

### .fsi

text: fsi_LoadFitout 0x4b1a20: '#' comments; .wdf/.gdf by extension, eng/sus/bra/spc by prefix

### .geo

Open76 GeoParser layout, verified by exact consumption

### .gpw

GAS0 + 6 i32 + RIFF WAVE

### .hzd

text: hzd_Load 0x401540: exactly 16 tokens split on ' ,	
' into 16-byte slots

### .lst

text: fullres.lst: tex_ApplyFullResFlag 0x471840 (hashed name set); internet.lst is shell-only

### .lum

256x256 shade table [level][colour]

### .m16

w, h|0x80000000, w*h u8 indices, u32 n, n x u16 RGB565 palette (flag set in every corpus file)

### .map

u32 w, u32 h, w*h indices

### .map_text

text: input bindings

### .msk

u16 list

### .mw2

mw2db.py: u32 count + offsets; members decoded to values and re-encoded (LZSS-packed PCX backgrounds, '1.10' shape tables, '1.' fonts; WAV and credits text held whole); consumer i76shell.dll TMPackDataBaseObj

### .npt

text: npt_Load 0x45dea0: <= 6 objectives ('(hidden)' prefix), then '(failure)' + <= 16 failure lines

### .pcf

text: pcf_Preload 0x4026c0: '<type p/t/x/v/a/g> <name>'; the trailing numbers are never parsed

### .pcx

ZSoft PCX

### .pix

text: count, then 'NAME.EXT offset size' per member of the sibling .pak (reader 0x470660: sscanf '%d' then '%s %d %d', names lowercased, qsorted)

### .rtm

text: road_LoadTextureManifest 0x48e1a0: up to 30 names (slots 10/10/5/5 over built-in defaults), 15 chars, blank lines ignored

### .smk

RAD Smacker 2 header + frame size/type tables parsed; trees and frames are RAD's codec (SMACKW32.DLL)

### .tab

65536 x u16 RGB565 colour grade

### .tbl

256x256 translucency [src][dst]

### .ter

N x 32 KiB tiles

### .tmt

64-byte header + 8-char frame names

### .vqm

u32 w, u32 h, cbk[12], u32, u16 per 4x4 block

### .wav

standard RIFF WAVE PCM (8-bit mono 11025 Hz); identity

### .zix

text: vfs_LoadZix 0x4b23e0: count, volume table, container table, 'index name' lines

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x0 | char[4] | magic | typed | '1.' 00 00 |  |
| 0x4 | u32 | count | typed | glyph count (256 or 144; 8,896 in the double-byte font) |  |
| 0x8 | u32 | height | cited | glyph height in pixels | Mcga_FontGetHeight 0x1003e423; Mcga_DrawChar 0x1003e4f0 |
| 0xc | u32 | flag | typed | 0xff in the 8-bpp fonts, 0 in the 1-bpp font |  |
| 0x10 | u32[count] | glyph_offset | cited | offset of each glyph from the start of the member, indexed by character code | Mcga_FontGetCharWidth 0x1003e436..0x1003e441; Mcga_DrawChar 0x1003e4fc |
| +0x0 | u32 | width | cited | glyph advance / bitmap width (0 = no bitmap in 8-bpp fonts) | 0x1003e444 |
| +0x4 | bytes | pixels | cited (8 bpp) | 8 bpp: width x height palette indices, 0xff transparent. 1 bpp: height rows of max(1, ceil(width/8)) bytes, MSB left (typed; reader not traced) | copy / colour-map loop 0x1003e593..0x1003e5c9, cmp al,0xff 0x1003e5b5 |
